description.value: Nook is a Vancouver-born Italian restaurant group that opened its first location in the West End in 2009, now with five Nook locations across Metro Vancouver plus sister restaurants Oddfish and Radish. The Coal Harbour location on Melville Street serves housemade pasta, wood-fired-style pizzas, and antipasto using locally sourced ingredients alongside imported Italian products. It's a casual neighbourhood spot with daily pizza and pasta specials, making it a solid sit-down refuelling stop for cyclists in the Coal Harbour area.
